title: Imperfect active endings
subtitle: Read ongoing or repeated past action.
overview: The imperfect uses secondary active endings and normally presents an action from within, in past time and indicative mood.
Translate flexibly: “was doing,” “used to do,” or simple past when English needs it.

sections.title: ἔλυον: core endings
rows: I was loosing; he or she was loosing
you all were loosing / they were loosing
